text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Aqsa intifada (uprising) ignited by rifles and stones. King Hussein calls for the impossible, to calm affairs; says Jerusalem is always in heart and conscience.
- Crown Prince Hassan tells Arab ministers of religious endowments that Jordan is working to protect Arab and Islamic identity.
Editorial - King's comments reflect Jordan's concern for massacres carried out by Israeli occupation forces.
- Palestinian-Israeli War enters second day. King says Jerusalem cannot be violated in any way.
- King speaks to Israeli President Weizman, Palestinian President Arafat, Saudi Crown Prince Abdullah and Egyptian President Mubarak.
